SELECT COUNT(*), pph.name as stageName FROM product_info p LEFT JOIN project_info pi ON p.id = pi.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN (select pt.product_id, COALESCE(min(pp.seq),max(ppe.seq)) as seq from project_task pt LEFT JOIN project_phase pp on pt.phase_id = pp.id and pt.product_id = pp.product_id and pt.status in (0,1,2,3,7,9,10) AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN project_phase ppe on pt.phase_id = ppe.id and pt.product_id = ppe.product_id and pt.status = 4 AND ppe.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY pt.product_id) pp on p.id = pp.product_id LEFT JOIN project_phase pph on pp.product_id = pph.product_id and pp.seq = pph.seq AND pph.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE P.delete_state = 0 AND p.is_finished_product_dev = 1 AND p.is_deleted = FALSE AND pph.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pph.name
